quotes: You don't have to feel ready. You just have to be willing to begin before you do.
Doubt will keep knocking. You don't have to answer every time.
The version of you that trusts yourself isn't louder, just steadier.
One brave, quiet decision today can change the whole direction of your year.
posts.caption:
Start before you feel ready. You'll catch up to yourself on the way. 🌿

Save this for the next time you're stuck.
